tagline: A whole analog vocal chain with pitch correction and a visual EQ, voiced after famous records
description: Put it on a vocal and pick a record: Phil Collins' In The Air Tonight, Pharrell and SexyBack-era Timberlake, Travis Scott hard tune, 808s-era Kanye, Tame Impala, R&B, trip hop and more. Underneath is a full chain you can change: pitch correction (key, scale, retune speed, humanize, flex, formant), mic voicing, saturation, an eight-band dynamic EQ you drag on a live analyzer, a vocal rider, FET / opto / vintage-limiter / VCA compression, de-esser, a resonance smoother, air, doubler, chorus and Dimension, a vocoder that follows your voice, tape, tape delay, reverb and a true-peak limiter.
highlights: In The Air Tonight (Phil Collins, 1981): a dynamic mic into a cheap old limiter at 6:1 with a slow attack, almost dry with a dark tape echo, plus the vocoder version for the second verse

Pitch correction that keeps the voice natural: notes are moved whole periods at a time (PSOLA), so vowels and timbre stay put; retune speed from instant (the robotic effect) to gentle, humanize for held notes, flex for slides, natural vibrato kept or flattened, transpose and formant shift

Visual EQ: eight bands you drag over a live analyzer of the voice before and after; each can be a bell, shelf, cut up to 48 dB/oct, notch, band-pass or tilt, on stereo, mid or side, and dynamic (it moves with the level in its band). Analog-matched curves stay true up to 20 kHz

Analog chain: mic voicing, tube / tape / console / crunch saturation (4x oversampled, tone, parallel mix), a vocal rider, and FET, opto, vintage-limiter or VCA compression with a sidechain filter and gain-reduction meter

Smooth (a resonance suppressor that tames harsh frequencies only while they ring), Air (mid and high air that stays smooth on esses), de-esser, doubler, chorus and Dimension widening, tape, a tape delay that ducks under the voice, plate / room / hall / chamber / gated reverbs and a true-peak limiter
Vocoder that plays the note you sing (and the chord of your key) with string, robot, choir or brass voices: no MIDI needed
31 presets, each a different record or job: DEON, 80s, 2000s, Travis Scott, Ye, Tame Impala, R&B, trip hop, moshc0re and studio essentials
installTips: Put Aircheck first on the vocal track (FL Studio: Mixer > vocal insert > slot 1), then pick a preset.
For pitch correction set Key and Scale to the song; Chromatic works anywhere but snaps to every semitone. Retune 0 ms is the hard robotic effect, 20 to 50 ms sounds natural.
It delays the sound by about 50 ms so the pitch correction can look ahead; FL Studio compensates automatically. To sing through it live, use a separate low-latency monitor.
previewNote: on a synthetic sung test phrase (slightly off pitch on purpose), so you hear the chain and the correction, not a real singer.

items: DEON: DEON's own chain (Spaced & Warm) built in: gate, a 1176 at 12:1, presence at 1.6 and 6.4 kHz and a 12 kHz air shelf after the compressor, a high de-esser, chorus into Dimension 2, a dark half-note ping-pong and a studio reverb

New EQ: eight bands, each a bell, shelf, 12-48 dB/oct cut, notch, band-pass or tilt, on stereo, mid or side, and optionally dynamic; analog-matched curves that keep their shape all the way to 20 kHz; before or after the compressor
Smooth: finds harsh resonances as they happen and turns down only those frequencies, only while they ring
Air: a mid and a high air band that open up breathy detail without making loud esses harsh
Saturation rebuilt (4x oversampled, tone and parallel mix), a vocal rider, a sidechain filter on the compressor, a true-peak limiter, chorus and Dimension widening; every preset reworked to use them

Presets you can make your own: Save opens a menu to save over the current preset (your version takes the factory preset's place and stays through updates), save as a new preset in any category, restore the factory version or delete one of yours; a star next to the name shows the sound has been edited. Your presets live in Music/ddeonmadeit/<plugin>/Presets and are never touched by an update
